camel_example: aliyun dts TransferInstanceClass --region cn-hangzhou --OrderType UPGRADE --DtsJobId r4yr723m1990000 --InstanceClass large --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
description_en: Upgrades or downgrades the specifications of a DTS instance
description_zh: 可以升级或降级DTS实例规格
kebab_example: aliyun dts transfer-instance-class --order-type UPGRADE --instance-class large --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --dts-job-id r4yr723m1990000 --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: TransferInstanceClass

parameters.help_en:
The instance specifications after the upgrade. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/208925.html to query the instance specifications before the upgrade.

Specifications supported by data migration instances: xxlarge, xlarge, large, medium, and small.
Specifications supported by data synchronization instances: large, medium, small, and micro.

For more information about the description and performance test results of each specification, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26606.html and https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26605.html
parameters.help_zh:
升级后的实例规格，可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/208925.html查询升级前的实例规格。

迁移实例支持的规格：xxlarge、xlarge、large、medium、small。
同步实例支持的规格：large、medium、small、micro。

关于各链路规格的说明及性能测试情况请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26606.html和https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26605.html
parameters.name: instance_class

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region in which the DTS instance resides. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141033.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the data migration or data synchronization task. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/209702.html to query the task ID
parameters.help_zh: 迁移或同步任务ID，可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/209702.html查询
parameters.name: dts_job_id

ChargeType.description_en:
The billing method. Valid values:
POSTPAY: pay-as-you-go.
PREPAY: subscription
ChargeType.description_zh:
付费类型，返回值：
POSTPAY：按量付费（后付费）。
PREPAY：包年包月（预付费）

DtsJobId.description_en: The ID of the data migration or data synchronization task

DynamicMessage.description_en:
The dynamic error message, which is used to replace the %s variable in the ErrMessage parameter.

If ErrMessage returns The Value of Input Parameter %s is not valid and DynamicMessage returns DtsJobId, the value of the request parameter DtsJobId is invalid
DynamicMessage.description_zh:
动态错误信息，用于替换返回参数ErrMessage错误信息中的%s。

如果ErrMessage返回The Value of Input Parameter %s is not valid，且DynamicMessage返回DtsJobId，则表示所传入的请求参数DtsJobId不合法

EndTime.description_en:
The time when the instance expires.

This parameter is returned only when ChargeType is set to PREPAY
EndTime.description_zh:
实例到期时间。

ChargeType为PREPAY，才会返回此参数

ErrCode.description_en: The error code returned if the call failed
ErrCode.description_zh: 调用出错时返回的错误码

ErrMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call failed
ErrMessage.description_zh: 调用错误时返回对应的错误信息
ErrMessage.example: The request processing has failed due to some unknown error.

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true: The request was successful.
false: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功。返回值：

true：请求成功。
false：请求失败
